g.text: Scenario: Review an exact final head
g.title: Trigger: A stacked PR or integrated candidate requests readiness. Preconditions: Repository and exact head SHA resolve.; Relevant validation and security events are present. Controls: repository_id; head_sha; manifest_digest; review_id; packet_digest Outputs: Exact-head review packet and review findings tied to evidence. Failures: Head change makes prior evidence stale.; Missing security evidence blocks readiness.; Out-of-scope context request is denied.; Codex output is retained as a finding, not approval. Signals: Stale-head rejection.; Packet digest.; Validation decision.; Security decision.; Review finding disposition.

ID: source_adapters Responsibility: Translate provider records into bounded canonical events. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: source_event_id; adapter_version; idempotency_key Invariants: Provider-specific differences do not change canonical identity fields. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: provenance_ledger Responsibility: Store typed facts, JSONB payloads, stable identities, and critical relationships. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: PostgreSQL State variables: run_id; event_id; repository_id; commit_sha; checkpoint_id Invariants: Critical references satisfy relational constraints.; Facts are append-only or dispositioned. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/ddl-constraints.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/queries-with.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation

ID: projection_worker Responsibility: Build lineage, stack, review, freshness, and query projections from immutable facts. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: projection_revision; source_event_id; lag Invariants: Projections can be rebuilt from the ledger. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/queries-with.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation

ID: read_model Responsibility: Serve current lineage, stack, review, and exact-head freshness queries. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: PostgreSQL read projection State variables: head_sha; review_status; projection_revision Invariants: A projection never authorizes a head different from its assessed head. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: validation_worker Responsibility: Run deterministic product, schema, policy, operational, and security checks. Owner: Operator-managed worker Runtime: Node.js and repository tools State variables: validation_id; commit_sha; manifest_digest; decision Invariants: Validation is bound to an exact revision and manifest. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/tabellio-validator.mjs:1#validation command @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/validation-runner.md:1#scheduler-agnostic worker @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: security_gate Responsibility: Run security-specific checks and emit bounded security evidence. Owner: Security reviewer and Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Trusted validation worker State variables: security_run_id; commit_sha; policy_decision Invariants: Agent claims never substitute for deterministic security evidence. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/operations-hardening.md:1#worker and control-ref hardening @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: context_broker Responsibility: Return bounded project-specific evidence and lessons to a review or agent run. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Read-only Node.js API or MCP tool State variables: request_scope; head_sha; packet_digest; access_decision Invariants: Context is scoped to the requester, project, repository, and exact head. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: codex_review Responsibility: Interpret bounded evidence, identify risks, and propose review findings. Owner: Review operator Runtime: Codex or compatible agent State variables: review_id; head_sha; finding_ids Invariants: Codex review does not replace deterministic gates or human approval. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/tabellio-review.mjs:1#review command @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents/integrations-observability @ current-2026-08-30

text.tspan: 1. Validation result event / canonical event API
2. Security result event / canonical event API
5. Read current lineage and review state / read-only query API
6. Resolve exact facts and digests / read-only PostgreSQL query
7. Provide bounded review context / MCP or read-only API
8. Review findings and outcome / validated review event API
